title: The brief is the first creative act
excerpt: Forgettable advertising usually starts long before the idea. It starts with a brief that asks for everything and commits to nothing.

title: One idea, two audiences: building campaigns for Kerala and the GCC
excerpt: The same brand can mean different things in Kochi and in Dubai. Good campaigns are built to travel without losing what made them work.

title: Performance marketing is a creative problem
excerpt: Targeting has become a commodity. When everyone can reach the same audience, the ad itself is what decides the result.
